s: o na ya sidDO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (svA॰-divA॰ ca-para॰-aka॰-aniw .) O, SizAtsati । na, sADnoti । ya, sADyati । sidDirnizpattiH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: sidDO svA॰ di॰ ca para॰ aka॰ aniw । sADnoti sADyati asAtsIt sizADayizati ।

m: षाण्ढ्य n. (fr. षण्ढ) the state of being a eunuch, impotence, Car. (printed शाठ्य).

v: na॰ zazWe mAse BavaH WaYa । mftasya ekAhona zazWamAse karttavye SrAdDaBede “AdyaM zARmAsike taTeti” smftiH “ekAhanyUnazaRmAse tasya viDAnam” ti॰ ta॰ raGu॰ ।
m: षाण्मासिक mf(ई)n. (fr. षण्मास) six-monthly, half-yearly, six months old, of six months' standing, lasting six months, Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. षण्-, मासिक)
षाण्मासिक m. N. of a poet, Cat.
a: षाण्मासिक — a. (की f.) Six monthly, half-yearly. {2} Six months’ old; मौक्तिकानां षाण्मासिकानां Vb. 1. 17.

m: षाण्मास्यी (ई), f. a six-monthly funeral ceremony (between the 170th and 180th day after a person's death), L.
षाण्मास्य mfn. = षाण्मासिक, ĀśvŚr. (cf. षण्-माय)

v: pu॰ zaRRAM mAtFRAmapatyam aR udAdeSe raparaH । kArttikeye tasya kfttikAtrikaM, gaNgA pfTivI pArvatI ceti zawa mAtaraH purARezu prAsadDAH । agnikumAraSabde tu tasya zaRRa mfzipatnInAM mAtftvaM darSitam ।
m: षाण्मातुर m. (fr. षष् + मातृ) ‘having six mothers’, N. of Kārttikeya (q.v.), L.
a: षाण्मातुरः — [षड् मातरोऽस्य] ‘Having six mothers,’ an epithet of Kārtikeya.

k.v: बाहुलेयस्तारकजिद्विशाखः शिखिवाहनः। षाण्मातुरः शक्तिधरः कुमारः क्रौञ्चदारणः। शृङ्गी भृङ्गी रिटिस्तुण्डी नन्दिको नन्दिकेश्वरः। कर्ममोटी तु चामुण्डा चर्ममुण्डा तु चर्चिका॥

m: षाण्ड m. N. of Śiva, L.
षाण्डश mf(ई). g. गौरादि.
षाह-विलास (or षह्जि-व्˚) m. N. of a musical work by Dhuṇḍi-vyāsa.
षामिल N. of a place, Cat.

s: ka sAmayoge । itikavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰ para॰-saka॰-sew .) ka, sAntvayati SokArttaM dayAluH । sizAntvayizati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: sAmayuktasampAdane ada॰ cu॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । sAntvayati te asasAntvat ta ।

m: षाडण्डक mfn. (fr. षड्-अण्ड) g. धूमादि (Kāś. खाडण्डक).
षाडहिक mfn. (fr. षड्-अह), Lāṭy.

s: puM, gAnam । rasaH । iti medinI ॥ rAgasya jAtiviSezaH । sa ca zawsvaramilitarAgarAgiRyO । yaTA, -- “OqavaH paYcaBiH proktaH svarEH zaqBistu zAqavaH ॥ sampUrRaH saptaBirjYeya evaM rAgastriDA mataH ॥” iti saNgItadarpaRam ॥
v: pu॰ zaqavati ava--ac svArTe aR । 1 gAne 2 rase ca medi॰ tayoH tatsaMKyakasvarAdimattvAt kaTAtvam । 3 mawsvaramilitarAge ca “OqavaH paYcaBiH proktA zaqBistu zAqavaH smftaH । sampUrRaH saptaBirjYeya evaM rAgastriDAmataH” saMgItadarpaRaH ।
m: षाडव m. (cf. खाडव and खाण्डव) confectionery, sweetmeats, Suśr.
N. of partic. Rāgas (also -राग), Saṃgīt.
a: षाडवः — 1 Passion, sentiment. --2 Singing, music. --3 (In music) A Rāga in which six of the seven primary notes are used, औडवः पंचभिः प्रोक्तः स्वरैः षड्भिस्तु षाडवः.

m: षाडविक m. a confectioner, R.

s: klI, (zaqguRA eva । “cAturvarRyAdInAM svArTe .” 5 । 1 । 124 । ityasya vArttikoktyA zyaY .) rAjYAM rAjyarakzaRe upAyAH zaw । yaTA । sanDAnAsanaM sanDiM kftvA ava sTAnam 1 । yAtrAsanDAnaM yudDArTayAnam 2 । vigfhyAsanaM vEraM kftvAvasTAnam 3 । yAtrAM saMparigfhyAsanaM SatrorBayapradarSanArTaM yAnaM pradarSya svasTAne avasTAnam 4 । dvEDIBAvaH uBayatra sanDIkaraRam 5 । anyezAM saMSrayaH durgAdermmahArAjasya vA ASrayaH 6 । iti mahABArate rAjaDarmmaH ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 2 । 93 । “zAqguRyamupayuYjIta SaktyapekzaM rasAyanam । BavantyasyEvamaNgAni sTAsnUni balavanti ca ॥”) zARmAturaH, puM, (zaRRAM mAtFRAmapatyamiti । “mAturutsaMKyAsaMBadrapUrvvAyAH .” 4 । 1 । 115 । iti aR । ukAraScAntAdeSaH .) kArttikeyaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: na॰ zawguRA eva zyaY । rAjYAM sanDivigrahAdizu zawsu guRezu “zAqguRyamupayuYjate” iti mAGaH । “zAqguRyamiti yat prAktaM tanniboDa yuDizWira! । sanDA nAsanamityeva yAtrAsanDAnameva ca । vigfhyAsanamityeva yAtrAM samparigfhya ca । dvEDIBAvastaTAnyezAM saMSrayo'Ta parasya ca” BA॰ SA॰ 69 a॰ “sanDAnAsanaM 1 sanDiM kftvA'vasTitiH yAtrAsanDAna yAnam2 । vigfhya vEraM kftvAvasTAnaM vigrahaH3 yAtrA samparigfhyAsanaM SatrorBayapradarSanArTaM yAnaM pradarSya svasTAne'vasTAna4 dvEDIBAva uBayatra sanDikaraRaM 5 parasyA'nyasyASrayA 6 durgAdemahArAjasya vA” nI॰ ka॰ । sanDiYca vigrahaM yAnamAsanAdi vadAmi te । yalavad vigfhItena sanDi kuryyAcCivAya ca । kapAla upahAraSca santAnaH saNgatastaTA । upanyAsaH pratIkAraH saMyogaH puruzAntaraH । adfzwanara Adizwa AtmApi sa qapagrahaH । parikramastaTA CinnastaTA ca paradUzaRam । skanDopaneyaH sanDiSca sanDayaH zoqaSeritAH । parasparopakAraSca mEtraH sambanDakastaTA । upahArASca catvArastezu muKyASca sanDayaH । bAlo vfdDo dIrGarogastaTA banDubahizkftaH । BIruko BIrukajano lubDo lubDajanastaTA । viraktaprakftiScEva vizayezvatiSaktimAn । anekacittamantraSca devabrAhmaRanindakaH । dEvopahatakaScEva dEvanindaka eva ca । durBikzavyasanopeto balavyasanasaqkulaH । svadeSasTo bahuripurmuktaH kAlena yaSca ha । satyaDarmavyapetaSca viSatiH puruzA amI । etEH sanDiM na kurvIta vigfhRIyAt tu kevalam । parasparApakAreRa puMsAM Bavati vigrahaH । Atmano'ByudayAkANkzI pIqyamAnaH pareRa vA । deSakAlabalopetaH prAraBeteha vigraham । rAjyastrIsTAnadeSAnAM jYAnasya ca valasya ca । apahAro mado mAnaH pIqA vEzayikI taTA । jYAnAtmaSaktiDarmARAM viGAto dEvameva ca । mitrArTaYcApamAnaSca taTA banDuvinASanam । BUtAnugrahavicCedastaTA maRqaladUzaRam । ekArTABiniveSitvamiti vigrahayonayaH । sApatnyaM vAstujaM strIjaM vAgjAtamaparADajam । vEraM paYcaviDaM proktaM sADanaM praSamaM nayet । kiYcitPalaM nizPaM vA sandigDaPalameva ca । tadAtve dozajananamAyatyAYcEva nizPalam । AyatyAYca tadAtve ca dozasaYjananaM taTA । aparijYAtavIryyeRa pareRa strIjito'pi vA । parArTaM strInimittaYca dIrGakAlaM dvijEH saha । akAladEvayuktena balodDatasaKena ca । tadAtve PalasaMyuktamAyatyAM Palavarjitam । AyatyAM PalasaMyuktaM tadAtve nizPalaM taTA । itImaM zAqaSaviDaM na kuryyAdeva vigraham । tadAtvAyatisaMSudDaM karma rAjA sadAcaret । hfzwaM puzwaM balaM matvA gfhRIyAd viparItakam । mitramAkranda AsAro yadA syurddaQaBaktayaH । parasya viparItaYca tadA vigrahamAcaret । vigfhya sanDAya taTA samBUyATa prasaNgataH । upekzayA ca nipuREryAnaM paYcaviDa smftam । paramparasya sAmarTyaviGAtAdAsanaM smftam । areSca vijigIzoSca yAnavat paYcaGA smftam । balinordvizatormaDye vAcAtmAnaM samarpayan । dvEDIBAvena tizWeta kAkAkzivadalakzitaH । uBayorapi sampAte seveta balavattaram । yadA dvAvapi necCetAM saMSlezaM jAtasaMvidO । tadopasarpet tacCutru maDikaM vA svayaM vrajet । ucCidyamAno kasinA nirupAvapratikriyaH । kulodDataM satyamAryyamAseveta balotkawam । taddarSanopAstikatA nityaM tadBAvaBAvitA । tatkAritapraSrayitA vfttaM saMSrayiRaH Srutam” agnipu॰ 23 a॰ । aDikaM kAmanda॰ nItiSAstre dfSyam ।
m: षाड्गुण्य n. (fr. षड्-गुण, q.v.) the aggregate of the six qualities, Kathās.
the six good qualities or excellencies, Car.; Śiś.
the six measures or acts of royal policy, Mn.; MBh. &c.
six articles of any kind, multiplication of anything by six, W.
a: षाड्गुण्यं — [षड् गुणा एव ष्यञ्] 1 The collection of six qualities. --2 Six expedients to be used by a king, six measures of royal policy; षाड्गुण्यमुपयुंजीत शक्त्यपेक्षी रसायनं Śi. 2. 93; see under गुण also. --3 Multiplication of anything by six. --4 Six properties. --Comp. --प्रयोगः employment of the six expedients or measures of royal policy.

m: षाड्गुण्य—गुण-वेदिन् mfn. acquainted with the virtues of the six measures, Mn. vii, 167.
षाड्गुण्य—प्रयोग m. the application or practice of the six m˚, MW.
षाड्गुण्य—संयुत mfn. connected or accompanied with the six measures, Mn. vii, 58.
षाड्गुण्य—वत् mfn. endowed with six excellencies, Ml.
षाड्रसिक mfn. (fr. षड्-रस) having six tastes or flavours, Car.
षाड्वर्गिक mfn. (fr. षड्-वर्ग) relating to the five senses and the Manas, BhP.
षाड्विध्य n. (fr. षड्-विध) sixfoldness, Kull. on Mn. viii, 76.

s: tri, zatvaRatvaviDAyakaSAstravyAKyAnam । tatra BavaH । yaTA । zatvaRatvayorviDAyakaM SAstraM zAtvaRatvaM tasya vyAKyAnAntatra Bavo vA zAtvaRatvikaH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥
v: tri॰ zatvaRatve aDikftya kfto granTaH Wak । zatvaRatvapratipAdake granye si॰ kO॰ ।
m: षात्वणत्विक mfn. (fr. षत्वनत्व) relating to or treating of the substitution of ष् for स् and ण् for न्, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 67, Sch.

v: avya॰ saha--Rvi--pfzo॰ zatvaM watvaYca । samboDane SabdArTakalpa॰ ।
m: षाट् ind. a vocative particle or interjection of calling, L.
a: षाट् — ind. A vocative particle.

m: षाट्कौशिक mfn. (fr. षष् + कोश) enveloped in six sheaths, Kauś.; Sarvad.
a: षाट्कौशिक — a. (की f.) Incased or enveloped in six sheaths.

m: षाट्कुल mfn. = षट्सु कुलेषु भवः, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 88.
षाट्पौरुषिक mfn. (fr. षष् + पुरुष) relating or belonging to six generations, MW.
a: षाट्पौरुषिक — a. (की f.) Belonging to six generations (पुरुष).

s: tri, zazWaH । zazWaSabdAt svArTe zRa (aR) pratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (puM, zazWo BAgaH । “zazWAzwamAByAM Ya ca .” 5 । 3 । 50 । iti YaH । iti sidDAntrakOmudI ॥)
m: षाष्ठ mfn. (fr. षष्ठ) the sixth (part), Pāṇ. v, 3, 50
taught in the sixth (Adhyāya), ib. viii, 1, 19, Sch.
a: षाष्ठ — (ष्ठी f.) Sixth.

m: षाष्ठिक mfn. belonging to the sixth, explained in the sixth (Adhyāya), MW.
षाष्ठिक n. taking food with milk every sixth day (a four-monthly fast), L.
षाष्टिक mfn. (fr. षष्टि) sixty years old, Pāṇ. v, 1, 58, Vārtt. 3, Pat.
(fr. षष्टिक) See क्षीर-षाष्टिक.
षाष्टिपथ mfn. = षष्टि-पथिक, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 60.

s: kzaye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰aka॰-aniw .) mUrdDanyAdiH । sAyati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: kzaye BvA॰ para॰ aka॰ aniw । sAyAta asAsIt ।

s: la SoDane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adA॰ para॰-aka॰-aniw .) mUrdDanyAdirayam । dantyAdirayamiti kaScit । la, snAti gaNgAyAM DIraH । anupasargasya YO jvalahvaletyAdinA hrasvo vA snapayati snApayati । sopasargasya tu prasnApayati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: SADane adA॰ para॰ aka॰ aniw । snAti asnAsIt ।

s: vezwe । iti kavikalpadrumaH (BvA॰-para॰-saka॰ aniw .) prakftyA dantyavargaSezopaDaH । snAyati vfkzaM latA । anupasargasya YO jvalahvaletyAdinA hrasvo vA । snapayati snApavati । sopasargasya tu prasnApayati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vazwe BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ aniw । snAyati asnAsIt । zRyE ityeke zRyAyati azRyAsIt । sna (snA) payati upasfzwasya pramnApayati ।

s: ya x u mi nivAse । iti kavikalpadrumaH । (divA॰-para॰-aka॰-sew । ktvAvew .) mUrdDanyAdirdantyanakArayuktaH । za, snasyati । x, asnasat । u, snasitA snustvA । mi, snasayati snAsayati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: nirAse di॰ para॰ saka॰ sew udit ktvA vew vA GawA॰ xdit । snasyati asnasat । sna (sna) sayati ।

s: U ya x Yi prItO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-para॰-aka॰-vew .) U, snehizyati snekzyati । ya, snihyati banDuH । x, asnihat । Yi, snigDaH snIQo'sti । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ka srehane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰ para-aka॰-sew .) snehanaM snigDIBAvaH । ka, snehayati varttikA tElena । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: prItO di॰ para॰ saka॰ udana vaw । snihyati xdit asnehat snehitA sneQA--BnegDA ।
snehayuktaBavane cu॰ uBa॰ aka॰ sew । snehayati te । asizRihat ta ।

s: Ya la stutO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adA॰ uBa॰-saka॰-aniw .) Ya la, stOti stavIti stute । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: stutO adA॰ u॰ saka॰ sew । snOti asnAvIt asnavizwa ।

s: Na secane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-saka॰-sew । snocate suzRuce । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: secane BvA॰ A॰ saka॰ sew । snocate asnocizwa suzRuce

s: ya U x udgAre । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-para॰-saka॰-vew .) dantyanakArayuktaH । udgAro vAntiH । ya, snuhyatyannaM lokaH । U, snohizyati snokzyati । x, asnuhat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: udgAre di॰ para॰ saka॰ Udit vaw । snuhyati xdit asnuhat । snohita snaQA ।

s: ya Bakze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰ para॰-saka॰-sew .) dantyanakArayuktaH । ya, snusyati suzRoma । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: makze di॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । snusyati asnosIt suzRosa ।

s: Na la sUtO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adA॰ Atma॰-saka॰-aniw .) mUrdDanyAdiH । Nala, sUte । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ya Na O sUtO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰ Atma॰-saka॰ aniw .) ya Na, sUyate । o, sUnaH । sUtirgarBavimocanam । sUte puttraM nArI । anyatrApi Darmmo'rTaM prasUyate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
Sa kzepe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰-para॰ saka॰-aniw .) mUrdDanyAdiH । Sa, suvati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: prasave garBavimocane ca adA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ vew । sUte suvE asavizwa asozwa ।
prasave di॰ A॰ sa॰ vew । sUyate asavizwa--asozwa aodit sUnaH
kzepe pretaRe ca tudA॰ para॰ saka॰ vew । suvati asAvIt ।

s: kzaRane । iti prAYcaH । (BvA॰-para॰-saka॰ sew .) kzaRanamavadAraRaM hiMsopalakzaRamiti ramAnATena vyAKyAtam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

ka ASrutihatyoH । nirAse । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰-para॰-saka॰-sew .) ASrutiraNgIkAraH । ka, sUdayati DanaM viprAya dAtuM dAtA । ramAnATastu AsravaRa iti dantyasakAraM paWitvA sUdayati madirA BARqAt kzarati ityarTa ityAha । iti durgAdAsaH ।
Na nirAse । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-saka॰-sew .) zazWasvarI । Na, sUdate । nirAso niHkzepaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: nivAraRe BvA॰ A॰ saka॰ sew । sUdate asUdizwa ।
mAraRe BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । sUdati asUdIt ।
kzaraRe aka॰ pratijYAyAM nirAse ca saka॰ ada॰ cu॰ uBa॰ sew । sUdayati teM asuzUdat ta ।

s: Na ya I stamBe । hiMse iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-Atma॰-stamBe aka॰-hiMse saka॰sew । nizWAyAM aniw .) Na ya, sUryyate । I, sUrRaH । kEScidayaM na manyate । stamBo jaqIBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: stamBe aka॰ hiMsane sa॰ di॰ A॰ sew । sUryyate asUrizwa Idit sUrRaH ।

s: nAdare । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) rePayuktaH । zazWasvarI । sUrkzati duzwaM lokaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: anAdare BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । sUrkzati asUrkzIt ।

s: Irze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰aka॰-sew .) sUrkzyati suzUrkzya । zadvayAnto'yamityeke । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: IrzAyAM BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । sUkzyati asUrkzyIt ।

s: prasave । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) zazWasvarI mUrdDanyAdiH । sUzati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

s: puM, (zaw AmnAyAH .) Sivasya zaqvaktravinirgatazawprakAratantraSAstram । yaTA, SrISiva uvAca । “aTedAnIM pravakzyAmi AmnAyakaTanaM pfTak । pUrvvAmnAyo yadA mantrastadA prAcIdiSi sTita sadASivo'haM BagavAnAcAraH parikIrttitaH । evaM vE dakziRAmnAyo dakziRasyAM diSi sTita evaM hi paScimAmnAyaH paScimAyAM diSi sTita evamevottarAmnAya uttarasyAM diSi sTitaH ॥ muKamUrdDakftaM devi ! yat proktaM tava sanniDO । UrdDAmnAyaSca kaTito devAnAmapi durllaBaH ॥ yadA cADomuKaM devi yat proktaM girije priye । aDa AmnAya ityuktaH satyaM satyaM sumaDyame । zaqAmnAyAScaM kaTitAScotpattikramanAmataH ॥ * ॥ yasmin yasmiMSca ye devAH kaTitASca varAnane । tAndevAMSca pravakzyAmi sADakAnAM hitAya bE ॥ SrIvidyABedasahitA tArA ca tripurA taTA । BuvaneSI cAnnapUrRA pUrvvAmnAye prakIrttitAH ॥ vagalAmuKI ca vaSinI tvaritA DanadA taTA । vaSinI bAlaBEravotyarTaH । mahizaGnI mahAlakzmIrddakziRAmnAyakIrttitAH ॥ mahAsvarasvatI vidyA taTA vAgvAdinI parA । pratyaNgirA BavAnI ca paScimAmnAyakIrttitAH ॥ kAlikA BedasahitA tArABedESca saMyutA । mAtaNgI BEravI cCinnA taTA DUmAvatI parA । uttarAmrAyakaTitAH kalO SIGraPalapradAH ॥ samastaBedasahitAH kAlikAyAH prakIrttitAH । dvAviMSatyakzarI tAsAM dakziRAsnAyakIrttitA ॥ ekajawA zaqAmnAye mahAmokzapradAyinI । tatparA paramA vidyA na vidyAntaragopitA ॥ paraprasAdamantraSca UrdDvAmnAye prakIrttitaH । vAgISvarAdayo devA aDa AmnAyakIrttitAH ॥ UrdDvAmnAyo aDaScEva kevalaM mokzado Bavet । DarmmArTakAmamokzArTe AmnAyAnye prakIrttitAH ॥ yaToktaviDinA Badre kftvA PalamavApnuyAt ॥ * ॥ pUrvvAmnAyAdisarvvAsAM viDAnaM SfRu sundari । kftvA yenASu laBate PalaM yaduttamottamam ॥ zawkarmmaPaladA nFRAM zaqAmnAyAH prakIrttitAH । uttarAmrAyo deveSi tezAmASu PalapradaH ॥” iti samayAcAratantre 2 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ tatra AmrAyaBedenAcAraBeda uktaH । yaTA, -- “pUrvvAmnAyoditaM karmma pASavaM kaTitaM priye । yaduktaM dakziRAmrAye tadeva pASavaM smftam ॥ paScimAmnAyajaM karmma paSuvIrasamASritam । uttarAmnAyajaM karmma divyavIrASritaM priye ॥ divyo'pi vIraBAvena sADayet pitfkAnane । vIrAsanaM vinA divyaH pUjayet pitfkAnane । UrdDvAmnAyoditaM karmma dizyaBAvASritaM priye ॥” iti niruttaratantre 1 pawalaH ॥

। yaduktaM dakziRAmnAye tadeva pASakaM smftam । paScimAmnAyajaM karma paSuvIrasamASritam । uttarAmnAyajaM karma divyavIrASritaM priye! । divyo'pi vIraBAvena sADayet pitfkAnane । vIrAsanaM vinA divyaH pUjayet pitfkAnane । UrdDvAmnAyoditaM karmadivyaBAvASritaM priye!” iti niruktatantre 1 pawale ।

s: klI, (zaRRAM cakrARAM samAhAraH .) SarIrasTapadmAkArazawprakAracakram । yaTA, -- “saptapadmAni tatrEva santi lokA iva praBo । gude pfTvIsamaM cakraM haridvarRaM caturddalam ॥ liNgetu zaqdalaM cakraM svADizWAnamiti smftam । trilokavahninilayaM taptacAmIkarapraBam ॥ nABO daSadalaM cakraM kuRqalinyA samanvitam । nIlAYjananiBaM brahmasTAnaM pUrvvakamandiram ॥ maRipUrABiDaM svacCaM jalasTAnaM prakIrttitam । udyadAdityasaMkASaM hfdi cakramanAhatam ॥ kumBakAKyaM dbAdaSAraM vEzRavaM vAyumandiram । kaRWe viSudDaSaraRaM zoqaSAraM purodayam ॥ SAmBavIvaracakrAKyaM candrabinduviBUzitam । zazWamAjYAlayaM cakraM dvidalaM Svetamuttamam ॥ rADAcakraMmiti KyAtaM manaHsTAnaM prakIrttitam । sahasradalamekArRaM paramAtmaprakASakam ॥ nityajYAnamayaM satyaM sahasrAdityasanniBam । zaw cakrARIha BedyAni nEtadBedyaM kaTaYcana ॥” iti pAdme svargaKaRqe 27 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “tattvasvarUpamekaM tat zawcakraM pratilakzayet । zawcakre'pi mahAmAyAM kzaRaM DyAtvA prayatnataH ॥ lambayenmUlamantreRa AdizoqaSacakrakam । AdizoqaSacakrasTAM sADakAnandakAriRIm ॥ cintayan sADako devIM japakarmma saBAraBet । Bruvorupari nAqInAM trayARAM prAnta ucyate । tatprAntaM tripaTasTAnaM zawkoRaM caturaNgulam ॥ raktavarRantu yogajYErAjYAcakramitIritam ॥ kaRWe trayARAM nAqInAM vezwanaM vidyate nfRAm । suzumneqApiNgalAnAM zawkoRaM tat zaqaNgrulam ॥ tat zawcakramiti proktaM SuklaM kaRWasya maDyagam । trayARAmaTa nAqInAM hfdaye cEkatA Bavet ॥ tatsTAnaM zoqaSAsraM syAt saptANgulapramARataH । tat pItamuktaM yogajYErAdizoqaSacakrakam ॥ DyAnAnAmaTa mantrARAM cintanasya japasya ca । yasmAdAdyaYca hfdayaM tasmAdAdIti gadyate ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 54 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aparaYca । “mUlADAre trikoRAKye icCAjYAnakriyAtmake maDye svayamBuliNgantu kowisUryyasamapraBam ॥ tadUrdDe kAmabIjantu ka-la-SAntIndUnAdakam । tadUrdDe tu SiKAkArA kuRqalI brahmavigrahA ॥ tadDAhye hemavarRABaM va-sa-varRacaturddalam । drutahemasamapraKyaM padmaM tatra viBAvayet ॥ tadUrdDe'gnisamapraKya zaqdalaM hIrakapraBam । vAdilAntazaqarRena yuktADizWAnasaMjYakam ॥ mUlamADArazawkAnAM mUlADAraM tato viduH ! svaSabdena paraM liNgaM svADizWAnaM tato viduH ॥ tadUrdDve nABideSe tu maRipUraM mahatpraBam । meGABaM vidyudABaYca bahutejomayaM tataH । maRivadBinnaM tat padmaM maRipUraM taTocyate ॥ daSaBiSca dalEryuktaM qAdiPAntAkzarAnvitam । SivenADizWitaM padmaM viSvalokEkakAraRam ॥ tadUrdDve'nAhataM padmamudyadAdityasanniBam । kAdiWAntAkzarErarkapatrESca samaDizWitam ॥ tanmaDye vARaliNgantu sUryyAyutasamapraBam । SabdabrahmamayaM Sabdo'nAhatastatra dfSyate ॥ tenAhatAKyaM padmaM tat muniBiH parikIrttyate । AnandasadanaM takzu puruzADizWitaM param ॥ tadUrdDvantu viSudDAKyaM dalazoqaSapaNkajam । svarEH zoqaSakEryuktaM DUmravarRaM mahatpraBam ॥ viSudDiM tanute yasmAt jIvasya haMsalokanAt । viSudDaM padmamAKyAtaM AkASAKyaM mahat param AjYAcakraM tadUrdDve tu AtmanADizWitaM param । AjYAsaMkramaRaM tatra gurorAjYeti kIrttitam ॥ kElAsAKyaM tadUrdDe tu boDanIntu tadUrdDataH । evaYca SivacakrARi proktAni tava suvrata ॥ sahasrArAmbujaM bindusTAnaM tadUrdDvamIritam । ityetat kaTitaM sarvaM yogamArgamanuttamam ॥” iti tantrasAraH ॥

षट्—कर्मन् n. the six duties of Brāhmans (viz. अध्ययन, ‘studying or repeating the Veda’, अध्यापन, ‘teaching the V˚’, यजन ‘offering sacrifices’, याजन, ‘conducting them for others’, दान, ‘giving’, and प्रतिग्रह, ‘accepting gifts’), ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn. &c. (the six daily duties accord. to the later law-books, are, स्नान, ‘religious bathing’, संध्याजप, ‘repetition of prayers at the three Saṃdhyās’, ब्रह्म-यज्ञ, ‘worship of the Supreme Being by repeating the first words of sacred books’, तर्पण, ‘daily oblations of water to the gods, sages, and Pitṛs’, होम, ‘oblations of fuel, rice &c. to fire’, देव-पूजा, ‘worship of the secondary gods either in the domestic sanctuary or in temples’), Parāś.; RTL. 394

six acts any one of which is allowable to a Brāhman householder as a means of subsistence (viz. ऋत, ‘gleaning’, अमृत, ‘unsolicited alms’, मृत, ‘solicited alms’, कर्षण, ‘agriculture’, सत्यानृत, ‘commerce or trade’, श्व-वृत्ति, ‘servitude’, the last being condemned), Mn. iv, 4, 5, 6, 9
six acts belonging to the practice of Yoga (viz. धौती, वस्ती, नेती, त्राटक, नौलिक, कपाल-भाती, these consist of suppressions of the breath and self-mortifications of various kinds), Cat.

six acts for inflicting various kinds of injury on enemies (viz. शान्ति, वश्य, स्तम्भन, विद्वेष, उच्चाटन, मारण, qq.vv.; these acts consist in repeating certain magical spells and texts taught in the Tantras), ib.
षट्—कर्मन् m. a performer of the above six acts, a Brāhman who is an adept in the Tantra magical formularies, Mn.; MBh.

vidvezoccAwane tataH । mAraRAntAni SaMsanti zawkarmmARi manIziRaH ॥ rogakftyA grahAdInAM nirASaH SAntirIritA । vaSyaM janAnAM sarvvezAM viDeyatvamudIritam ॥ pravfttiroDaH sarvvezAM stamBanaM syurvvasantAdyAH ahorAtraM dine dine । vasantagrIzmavarzAKyaSaradDemantaSESirAH ॥” yadvA, -- “ardDarAtraM SaratkAlo hemantaSca praBAtakaH । pUrvvAhRaSca vasantaH syAt maDyAhno grIzma eva ca ॥ prAvfqarUpo'parAhRaH syAt pradozaH SiSiraH smftaH ॥” aTavA, -- “Uzoyoge ca hemantaH praBAte SiSirAgamaH । praharArdDe vasantaH syAt grIzmo maDyandinAgame । turyyayAme ca varzAKyaH SaradastaM gate ravO ॥” * ॥ aTa kAlaniyamaH । “hemantaH SAntike prokto vasanto vaSyakarmmaRi । SiSiraM stamBane prokto vidveze grIzma eva ca । prAvfquccAwane jYeyA SaranmAraRakarmmaRi ॥” * ॥ aTa tiTiniyamaH । “graYcamo ca riktArke mftyuyoge ca mAraRam ॥ * japet pUrvvamuKo vaSye dakziRaYcABicArake । paScime stammanaM vidyAt uttare SAntikaM Bavet ॥ AkarzaRamaTAgneye nErfte mAraRaM taTA । uccAwanantu vAyavye ESAnyAM mokzadAyakam ॥ * ॥ aTABicAre kAryyA ca dakziRAplavanA mahI । vasanaM lohitaM proktaM uzRIzaM lohitaM smftam ॥ BUzaRaM lOhadravyeRa vAmena pUjanAdikam । narasnAyuviSezeRa mAraRe rajjurIritA mftasya vidveze vyoma korttitam ॥ uccAwane smfto vAyurBUyo'gnirnmAraRe smftaH । tattadBUtodaye samyak tattanmaRqalasaMyutam । tattat karmma viDAtavyaM mantriRA niScitAtmanA ॥ * SItAMSusalilakzORIvyomavAyuhavirBujAm । varRaH syurmmantrabIjAni zawkarmmasu yaTAkramam ॥ granTanaYca vidarBaSca saMpuwo roDanaM taTA । yogaH pallava ityete vinyAsyAH zawsu karmmasu ॥ mantrArRAntaritAn kuryyAt sADyavarRAn yaTAvriDi । granTataM tadvijAnIyAt praSastaM SAntikarmmaRi ॥ mantrARadvayamaDyastaM sADyAnAmAkzaraM liKet ॥ vidarBa eza vijYeyo mantriBirvvaSyakarmmaRi ॥ AdAyante ca mantraH syAnnAmnAsO saMpuwaH smftaH । eza syAt stamBane Sasta ityukto mantravediBiH ॥ nAmna AdyantamaDyezu mantraH syAdroDanaM matam । vidvezaRaviDAnezu praSastamidamIritam ॥ mantrasyAnte BavennAmayogaH proccAwane mataH । ante nAmno BavenmantraH pallavo mAraRe mataH ॥ sitaraktapotamiSrakfzRaDUmrAH prakIrttitAH । varRato mantrasaMproktA devatAH zawsu karmmasu ॥ * ॥ mantrARAM liKanadravyaM candanaM rocanaM niSA । gfhaDUmacitANgArO mAraRe'zwa vizARi ca ॥ SyenAgnilolapittAni DustUrakarasastataH । gfhaDUmastrikawukaM vizAzwakamitIritam ॥ devatAkAlamudrAdIn samyak jYAtvA vicakzaRaH । zawkarmmARi prayuYjIta yaToktaPalasidDaye ॥ * ॥ uccAwane vazaw proktaM hU~ PaqantaSca mAraRe । stanBane ca namaH proktaM svAhA SAntikapOzwike ॥ homatarpaRayoH svAhA nyAsapUjanayornnamaH । mantrAnte yojayenmantrI japakAle yaTAsTiti ॥” asyArTaH etAni tattatkarmmaRi japakAle mantrAnte yojayitvA mantraM japet । homAdizu nAyaM niyamaH । homa iti kaScit tanna । “agnikAryye japet svAhA namaH sarvvatra cArccane SAntipuzwivaSadvezAkarzoccAwanamAraRe ॥ svAhA-svaDA-vazaw-hUYca vOzaw Paw yojayet kramAt । vaSyAkarzaRasantApajvare svAhA prakIrttitA ॥ kroDopaSamane SAntO prItO yojyaM namo buDEH । vOzaw sammohanoddIpapuzwimftyuYjayezu ca ॥ hUNkAraM prItinASe ca mAraRe cCedane taTA । uccAwane ca vidveze vazaw paNgukftO vazaw । mantroddIpanakAryyezu lABAlABe vazaw smftaH ॥” iti viSezavacanAdDome nAyaM viDiH ॥ * ॥ SAntikAdO mantraliKanapatrAdiniyamastatra eva “SAntike rAjataM tAmraM BUrjjapatraYca vaSyake । sarvvakAryyEzu sOvarRaM krUre syAt pretakarpawam ॥ triganDaM SAntike proktaM paYcaganDantu vaSyake । sarvvakAryye'zwaganDaH syAt krUre cAzwavizARi ca SAntike leKanI dUrvvA vaSyAdO SiKipucCikA ॥ hemrA sarvvARi kAryyARi krUre syAt kAkapucCikA ॥ gfhezu SAntikarmma syAt vaSyaYca caRqikAgfhe devAlaye ca sarvvARi SmaSAne krUrakarmma ca ॥” * ॥ aTa BUtAnAmudayaH । “daRqAkArA gatirBUmeH puwayoruBayorapi । toyasya pAvakasyordDe gatistiryyak naBasvataH ॥ gatirvyomno BavenmaDye mUtAnAmudayaH smftaH । DaraRerudaye kuryyAt stamBanaM vaSyamAtmavit ॥ SAntikaM pOzwikaM karmma toyasya samaye vasoH । mAraRAdIni maruto vipakzoccAwanAdike । kzveqAdinASane Sastamudaye ca vihAyasaH ॥” * ॥ aTa BUtAnAM maRqalAni । “vfttaMdivastat zaqbindulAYCitaM mAtariSvanaH trikoRaM svastikopetaM vahnerardDendusaMyutam ॥ amBojasanBaso BUmeScaturasraM savajrakam । tattadBUtasamABAni maRqalAni vidurbuDAH ॥ varREH sve raYjitAnyAhuH svasvanAmAvftAnyapi । svayaM viyat marut kfzRo rakto'gnivizadaM payaH ॥” pIqABUtAdiprayogAnantaraM kulArRave । “ekalakzaM japenmantraM DyAnanyAsasamanvitam । prayogadozaSAntyarTamAtmarakzArTakAraRam na cet PalaYca nApnoti devatASApamApnuyAt ॥” yattu । “na SastaM mAraRaM karmma kuryyAccedayutaM japet .” tat prAyaScittaparam । iti tantrasAraH ॥ * ॥ yogANgazawprakArakriyA । tadyaTA, -- “DOtirvastistaTA netirnOlikI trAwakastaTA । kapAlaBAtiScEtAni zawakarmmARi samAcaret ॥ antaDOtirddantarDOtihf dDOtirmalaSoDanam । DOtyaScaturviDAH proktA GawaM kurvvanti nirmmalam ॥ vAtasAraM vArisAraM vahrisAraM bahizkftam । Gawasya nirmmalArTAya antarDOtiScaturviDA ॥” * ॥ prayogaH । “kAkacaYcuvadAsyena pibedvAyuM SanEH SanEH । cAlayedudaraM paScAdvartmanA recayet SanEH ॥ vAtasAraM paraM gopyaM dehanirmmalakArakam । sarvvarogakzayakaraM dehAnalavivardDakam ॥ 1 ॥ AkaRWaM purayedvAri vaktreRa ca pibet SanEH । cAlayedudareREva codarAdrecayedaDaH ॥ vArisAraM paraM DOtaM dehanirmmalakArakam । sADayedyaH prayatnena devadehaM prapadyate ॥ 2 ॥ nABigranTiM merupfzWaM SatavAraYca kArayet । udarAmayajAM tyaktvA jaWarAgniM vivardDayet । vahnisAramidaM DOtaM yoginAM yogasidDidam ॥ 3 ॥ kAkImudrAM sADayitvA purayedudaraM marut । DArayedardDayAmantu cAlayedaDavartmanA ॥ idaM DOtaM paraM gopyaM na prakASyaM kadAcana । nABimagnajale sTitvA SaktinAqIM visarjjayet ॥ karAByAM kzAlayennAqIM yAvanmalavisarjjanam । tAvat prakzAlya nAqIYca udare veSayet punaH ॥ idaM prakzAlanaM gopyaM devAnAmapi durllaBam । kevalaM DOtimAtreRa devadeho Bavet Druvam ॥ yAmArdDaDAraRAt SaktiM yAvanna sADayennaraH । vahizkftamahadDOtistAvannEva na jAyate ॥ 4 ॥ dantamUlaM jihvAmUlaM ranDre ca karRayugBayoH । kapAlaranDraM paYcEte dantaDOtirviDIyate । ॥ *” ॥ prayogaH “KAdireRa rasenATa mfttikABiSca SudDiBiH । mArjjayeddantamUlaYca yAvat kilvizamAharet ॥ dantamUlaM paraM DOtiryoginAM yogasADane । nityaM kuryyAt praBAte ca dantarakzAya yogavit ॥ dantamUlaM DAraRAdikAryyezu yoginAM yataH । 1 । aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi jihvASoDanakAraRam ॥ jarAmaraRarogAdi nASayet dIrGalambikA । tarjjanI maDyamAnAmA aNgulitrayayogataH ॥ veSayedgalamaDye tu mArjjayellambikAmalam । SanEH SanErmmArjjayitvA kaPadozaM nivArayet ॥ mArjjayennavanItena dohayecca punaH punaH । tadagraM lohayantreRa GarzayitvA punaH punaH ॥ nityaM kuryyAt prayatnena raverudayake'stake । evaM kfte tu nitye ca lambikA dIrGatAM gatA ॥ 2 tarjjanyaNgulyakAgreRa mArjjayet karRaranDrayoH । nityamaByAsayogena nAdAntaraprakASanam ॥ 3 ॥ 4 ॥ vfdDANguzWena dakzeRa mArjjayedBAlaranDrakam । evamaByAsayogena kaPadozaM nivArayet ॥ nAqInirmmalatAM yAti divyadfzwiH prajAyate । nidrAnte BojanAnte ca divAnte ca dine dine ॥ 5 hfdDOtiM triviDAM kuryyAt daRqavajjalavAsasA । ramBAdaRqaM hariddaRqaM vetradaRqantaTEva ca ॥ hfmaDye cAlayitvA tu punaH pratyAharet SanEH । kaPapittaM taTA kledaM recayedUrdDavartmanA । daRqaDOtiviDAnena hfdrogaM nASayet Druvam ॥” hariddaRqaM vawaJuri ॥ 1 ॥ “BojanAnte pibedvAri AkaRWaM pUrRitaM suDIH । UrdDvadfzwiM kzaRaM kftvA tajjalaM vamayet punaH । nityamaByAsayogo'yaM kaPapittaM nivArayet ॥ 2 caturaNgulavistAraM sUkzmavastraM SanErgraset । punaH pratyAharedetat procyate DOtakarmmakam ॥ gulmajvaraplIhakuzWaM kaPapittaM vinaSyati । ArogyaM balapuzwiSca Bavettasya dine dine ॥ 3 ॥ apAnakrUratAM tAvanmalaM yAvanna SoDayet । tasmAt sarvvaprayatnena malaSoDanamAcaret ॥ pItamUlasya daRqena maDyamANgulinApi vA । yatnena kzAlayedguhyaM vAriRA ca punaH punaH ॥ vArayet kozWakAWinyamAmAjIrRaM nivArayet । kAraRaM kAntipuzwyoSca dIpanaM vahnimaRqalam ॥ * ॥ jalavastiH SuzkavastirvastI ca dviviDO smftO । jalavastiM jale kuryyAt SuzkavastiM kzitO sadA ॥ nABimagnajale pAyuM nyastanAlotkawAsanam । AkuYcanaM prakASaYca jalavastiM samAcaret ॥ pramehaYca gudAvarttaM krUravAyuM nivArayet । Bavet svacCandadehaSca kAmadevasamo Bavet ॥” nyastanAlotkawAsanaM Urudvaye hasta dattvA SAraNgavadudaraM kuryyAdityarTaH । 1 । “vastiM paScimatAnena cAlayitvA SanEH SanEH । aSvinImudrayA pAyuM AkuYcayet prakASayet ॥ evamaByAsayogena kozWadozo na vidyate । vivardDayet jAWarAgniM AmavAtaM vinASayet ॥ 2 vitastimAnaM sUkzmasUtraM nASAnAle praveSayet । muKAnnirmamayet paScAt procyate netikarmmakam ॥ sADanAnnetikarmmApi KecarIsidDimApnuyAt । kaPadozA vinaSyanti divyadfzwiSca jAyate ॥ * ॥ amandavege tundaYca BrAmayeduBapArSvayoH । sarvvarogAnnihantIha dehAnalavivardDanam ॥” iti nOlikI ॥ * ॥ “nimezonmezakaM tyaktvA sUkzmalakzyaM nirIkzayet । yAvadaSru nipatati trAwakaM procyate buDEH ॥ evamaByAsayogena SAmBavI jAyate Druvam । na jAyate netrarogo divyadfzwipradAyakam ॥ * ॥ sItkftya pItvA vaktreRa nAsAnAlErvirecayet । vyutkrameRa vyutkrameRa sItkrameRa viSezataH ॥ BAlaBAtiM triDA kuryyAt kaPadozaM nivArayet ॥ IqayA pUrayedvAyuM recayet piNgalayA punaH । piNgalayA pUrayitvA punaScandreRa recayet ॥ pUrakaM recakaM kftvA vegena na tu DArayet । evamaByAsayogena kaPadozaM nivArayet ॥ * ॥ nAsAByAM jalamAkfzya vaktreRa recayet punaH । pAyaM pAyaM prakurvvaMScet SlezmadozaM nivArayet ॥ na jAyate vArdDakaYca jvarI nEva prajAyate ॥” iti GeraRqasaMhitAyAM zawkarmmaSoDanaM praTamo'DyAyaH ॥

4zawkriyABede yaToktaM zeraRqasaM॰ 1 a॰ । “DOtirvastistaTA netirnOlikI trAwakastaTA । kapAlaBAtiScEtAti zaw karmARi samAcaret । antarDO tirdantaDOtirhfdDItirmalaSoDanam । DOtyaScaturviDAH prAktA GawaM (veha) kurvanti nirmalam । vAtasAraM vArisAraM vahnisAra bahizkf ma । Gawasya nirmalArTAya antarDOtiruturviDA” । “kAkacaYcuvadAsvena pibedvAyuM SanEH SanEH । cAlayedudaraM paScAdvartmanA recayet SanEH । vAtasAraM paraM gopyaM dehanirmalakArakam । sarvarogakzayakaraM dehAnalavivardDakam । AkaRWaM pUrayedvAri vaktreRa ca pivet SanEH । cAlayedudareSEva codarAdrevayedaDaH । vArimAraM paraM DotaM yogAsadDidam । kAkIM mudrAM sADavitvA pUrayetudaraM marut । DArayedardDayAmastu cAlavedaDavartmanA । idaM DOtaM paraM gopyaM na prakASya kadAcana । nABimagnajale syitvA SaktinAqIM visarjayet । karAByAM kzAlayennAqIM yAvanmalavisarjavam । tAvat pakzAlya nAqIYca udare veSayet punaH । idaM prakzAlanaM gopyaM devAnAmagi durlaBam । kevalaM DOtimAtreRa devadeho Bavet Druvam । yAmArdDa DAraRAt SAktaM yAvanna sADayennaraH । vahizkftamahADOti tAvannEva na jAyaDe । dantamUlaM jihvAmUlaM ranGre ca karRayugmayoH । kapAlaranDaM paYcEte dantaDorviDIyate” । “KAHdARa rasenATa mfttikABiSca SudDiBiH । mArkzayeddantamUlaYca yAvat kilvizamAharet dantamUlaM paraM zOtiryo ganAM yogayADana । nityaM kuryyAt praBAte ca dantarakzAya yogavit । dantamUlaM DAraRAdikAryyezu yoginAM yataH । spapAtaH sapravakzyAmi jihvASoDanakAraRam । jarAmaraRaromAdi nASayat dirGalambikA । tarjanImaDyamAnAmA aNguka trayayogataH । vaSayedgalamaDye tu mArjayella mbakAmalam । SanEH SanErmArjayitvA kaPadozaM nivArayet । mArjayennavanItena dehayecca punaH punaH । tadagraM lOhayantreRa GarzayitvA punaH punaH । nityaM kuryyAt prayatnena raverudayake'stake । evaM kfte tu nitye'valambikA dArGatAM gatA । tarjanyaNgulyakAgreRa mArjayet karRaranGrayoH । nityamaByAsa yogena nAdAntaraprakASanam । vfdDANguzWena dakzeRa mArjayedBAlaranGrakam । emaByAsayogena kaPadozaM nivArayet nAqI nirmalatAM yAti divyadfzwiH prajAyate । nidrAnte BojanAnte ca divAnte ca dine dine । hfdDO tiM triviDaM kuryyAt daRqavajjalavAsasA । ramBAdaRqaM hariddaRqaM vetraddaRqantaTEva ca । hfnmaDye cAlayitvA tu punaH pratyAharet SanEH । kaPapittaM taTA kledaM recayedUrdDvavartmanA । daRqavOtiviDAnena hfdrogaM nASayet Druvam” । hariddaRqaM (vawaJuri) “BojanAnte zibedvAri AkaRWapUrRitaM suDIH । UrdDvadfzwiM kaRa kftvA tajjasraM vamayet punaH । nivyamayAsayogo'yaM kaPapittaM nivArayet । caturaNgalavistAraM sUkzmavastraM SanErgramet । punaH pratyAharedetat procyate DOtakarmakam । gulmjvaraplIhakuzWaM kaPapittaM vinaSyati । cArogyaM balapuzwiSca Bavettasya dine dine । apAnakrUratAM tAvanmalaM yAvanna SoDayet । tasmAt sarvapayatnena malaSoDanamAcarat । pItamUlasya daRqena maDyamANgulinApi vA । yatnena kzAlayed guhyaM vAriRA ca punaH punaH । vArayet kAzWakAWinya mAmAjorRaM nivArayet । kAraRaM kAntipuzwyoSca dIpanaM vahnimaRqalam । jalavastiH SuzkavastirvastI ca dviviDO smftO । jalavastiM jale kuryyAt SuzkavastiM kzitO sadA । nABipagnajale pAyuM nyastanAlotkawAsanam । AkuYcanaM prasAraYca jakavasti samAcaret । pramehaYca gudAvarttaM krUravAyuM nivArayet । Bavet svacCandadehaSca kAmadevasago Bayet” । nyastanAlotkawAsanam Urudvaya hastaM dattvA SAraNgavadudaraM kuryyAdityarTaH । “vastiM paScimatAnena cAlayitvA SanEH SanEH । aSvinImudUyA pAyumAkuYcecca prasArayeta । evamaByAsayogena kozWadAzo na vidyate । vardDaryet jaWarAgniYca AmavAtaM vinASayet । vitastima sUkzmasataM nAsAnAre praveSayet । muKannirgamayet paScAt procyate netikarmakam । sADanAnnetikarmaRaH KecarIM sidDimApnuyAt । kaPadozA m: षष् mfn. pl. (prob. for orig. षक्ष्; nom. acc. षट् instr. षड्भिस् dat. abl. षड्भ्यस्, gen. षण्णाम् loc. षट्सु; in comp. षष् becomes षट् before hard letters, षड् before soft, षो before द्, which is changed into ड्, and ण् before nasals) six (with the counted object in apposition or exceptionally in gen. or ifc., e.g. षड् ऋतवह्, or षड् ऋतुनाम्, ‘the six seasons’, षट्सु षत्सु मासेषु, ‘at periods of six months’, Mn. viii, 403 at the end of a Bahuvrīhi compound it is declined like other words ending in ष्, e. g. प्रिय-षषस् nom. pl. Pāṇ. vii, 1, 22 Schol.; among the words used as expressions for the number six (esp. in giving dates) are अङ्ग, दर्शन, तर्क, रस, ऋतु, वज्रकोण, कार्त्तिकेय-मुख), RV. &c. &c.
(in gram.) a tech. N. for numerals ending in ष् and न् and words like कति, Pāṇ. i, 1, 24, 25
षष् [cf. Gk. ἕξ; Lat. sex; Goth. saíhs; Germ. sëhs, sechs; Eng. six.]
a: षष् — num. a. (used in pl., nom. षट्; gen. षण्णां) Six; Ms. 1. 16, 8. 403. --Comp. --अक्षीणः (षडक्षीणः) a fish. --अंगं (षडंगं) {1} six parts of the body taken collectively:--जंघे बाहू शिरो मध्यं षडंगमिदमुच्यते. {2} the six works auxiliary to the Veda; शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छंदसां चितिः . ज्योतिषामयनं चैव षडंगो वेद उच्यते; see वेदांग also. {3} six auspicious things, i. e. the six things obtained from a cow:--गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं सर्पिर्दधि च रोचना . षडगमेतन् मांगल्यं पठितं सर्वदा गवाम्. {3} any set of six articles. ˚जित् m. N. of Viṣṇu. --अंघ्रिः (षडंघ्रिः) a bee. --अधिक a. ( षडधिक) exceeded by six; Māl. 5. 1. --अभिज्ञः (षडभिज्ञः) a Buddhist deified saint. --अशीत a. (षडशीत) eighty-sixth. --अशीतः f. (षडशीतिः) eighty-six. --अहः (षडहः) a period of six days. --आननः, --वक्त्रः, --वदनः (षडाननः, षड्वक्त्रः, षड्वदनः) epithets of Kārtikeya; षडाननापीतपयोधरासु नेता चमूनामिव कृत्तिकासु R. 14. 22. --आम्नायः (षडाम्नायः) the six-fold Tantra. --ऊषणं (षडूषणं) six spices taken collectively; पंचक्रोलं समरिचं षडूषणमुदाहृतम्. --कर्ण a. (षट्कर्ण) heard by six ears; i. e. by a third person other than the speaker and the person spoken to, told to more than one listener (as a counsel, secret &c.); षट्कर्णो भिद्यते मंत्रः Pt. 1. 99. --(र्णः) a kind of lute. --कर्मन् n. (षट्कर्मन्) {1} the six acts or duties enjoined on a Brāhmaṇa; they are:--अध्यापनमध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा . दानं प्रतिग्रहश्चैव षट्कर्माण्यग्रजन्मनः Ms. 10. 75. {2} the six acts allowable to a Brāhmaṇa for his subsistence; उंछं प्रतिग्रहो भिक्षा वाणिज्यं पशुपालन . कृषिकर्म तथा चेति षट्कर्माण्यग्रजन्मनः ... {3} the six acts that may be performed by means of magic; शांति, वशकिरण, स्तंभत, विद्वेष, उच्चाटन, and मारण. {4} the six acts belonging to the practice of Yoga; धौतिर्वस्ती तथा नेती नीलिकी (नौलिकी) त्राटकस्तथा . कपालभाती चैतानि षट्कर्माणि समाचरेत्. (--m.) {1} a Brāhmaṇa skilled in the above six acts. {2} one well-versed in the Tantra magical rites. --कोण a. (षटकोण) hexangular. --(णं) {1} a hexagon. {2} the thunderbolt of Indra. --गया the sixfold gayā; गयागजो गयादित्यो गायत्री च गदाधरः . गया गयासुरश्चैव षड्गया मुक्तिदायकाः ... --गवं (षड्गवं) {1} a team or yoke of six oxen. {2} a yoke of six (sometimes after the names of other animals); e. g. हस्ति˚, अश्व˚ ‘six elephants, horses &c.’. --गुण a. (षड्गुण) {1} sixfold. {2} having six attributes. --(णं) an assemblage of six qualities. {2} the six expedients to be used by a king in foreign polities; see under गुण (21); cf. षाड्गुण्य also. --ग्रंथि n. (षड्ग्रंथि) the root of long pepper. --ग्रांथिका (षड्ग्रंथिका) zedoary (शठी). --चक्रं (षट्चक्रं) the six mystical circles of the body. --चत्वारिंशत् ( षट्चत्वारिंशत्) forty-six. --चरणः ( षट्चरणः) {1} a bee; Ś. 1. 23. {2} a locust. {3} a louse. --जः (षड्जः) the fourth (or first according to some) of the seven primary notes of the Indian gamut; so called because it is derived from the six organs: --नासां कंठमुरस्तालु जिह्वां दतांश्च संस्पृशन् . षड्जः संजायते (षड्भ्यः संजायते) यस्मात्तस्मात् षड्ज इति स्मृतः; it is {{asid->said||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} to resemble the note of peacocks; षड्जं रौति मयूरस्तु Nārada; षड्जसंवादितीः केकाः द्विधा भिन्नाः शिवंडिभिः R. 1. 39. --त्रिंशत् f. ( षट्त्रिंशत्) thirty-six; (षट्त्रिंश a. thirtysixth). --दर्शनं (षडदर्शनं) the six principal systems of Hindu philosophy; they are:--सांख्य, योग, न्याय, वैशेषिक, मीमांसा, and वेदांत. --(नः) one conversant with the above six systems. --दीर्घः the six long vowels:-- आ, ई, ऊ, ऐ, and औ. --दुर्गं (षड्दुर्गं) the six kinds of forts taken collectively; धन्वदुर्गं महीदुर्गं गिरिदुर्गं तथैव च . मनुष्यदुर्गं मृद्दुर्गं वनदुर्गामिति क्रमात् .. --नवति f. ( षण्णवतिः) ninety-six. --पंचाशत् f. ( षट्पंचाशत्) fifty-six. --पदः (षट्पदः) {1} a bee; न पंकजं तद्यदलीनषट्दं न षट्पदोऽसौ न जुगुंज यः कलं Bk. 2. 19; Ku. 5. 9; R. 6. 69. {2} a louse. {3} a verse consisting of six padas. ˚अतिथिः {1} the mango tree. {2} the Champaka tree. ˚आनंदवर्धनः the Aśoka or Kinkirāta tree. ˚ज्य a. having bees for the bow-string (as the bow of Cupid); प्रायश्चापं न वहति भयान्मन्मथः षट्पदज्यं Me. 73. ˚प्रियः the tree called नागकेशर. --पदी (षट्पदी) {1} a stanza consisting of six lines. {2} a female bee. {3} a louse. --प्रज्ञः (षट्प्रज्ञः) {1} one who is well acquainted with six subjects; i. e. the four Puruṣārthas or objects of human existence, the nature of the world, and the nature of the Supreme Spirit; धर्मार्यकाममोक्षेषु लोकतत्त्वार्थयोरपि . षट्सु प्रज्ञा तु यस्यासौ षट्प्रज्ञः परिकीर्तितः ... {2} a lustful or licentious man. --बिंदुः (षड्बिंदुः) an epithet of Viṣṇu. --भागः ( षड्भागः) a sixth part, onesixth; Ś. 2. 13; Ms. 7. 131, 8. 33. --भुज a. (षड्भुज) {1} six-armed. {2} six-sided, hexagonal. --(जः) a hexagon. --(जा) {1} an epithet of Durgā. {2} the water-melon. --मासः (षण्मासः) a period of six months. --मासिक a. ( षण्मासिक) half-yearly, occurring every six months. --मुखः (षण्मुखः) an epithet of Kārtikeya; R. 17. 67. --(खा) a water-melon. --रसं, --रसाः (m. pl.) (षड्रसं &c.) the six flavours taken collectively; see under रस. --रात्रं (षड्रात्रं) a period of six nights. --रेखा (षड्रेखा) a water-melon. --वर्गः (षड्वर्गः) {1} an aggregate of six things. {2} especially, the six enemies of mankind; (also called षड्रिपु); कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो मदमोहौ च मत्सरः; कृतारिषड्वर्गजयेन Ki. 1. 9; व्यजेष्ट षड्वर्गं Bk. 1. 2. --विंशतिः f. ( षड्विंशतिः) twenty-six; (षड्विंश twentysixth). --विध (षड्विध) a. of six kinds, sixfold; R. 4. 26. --शास्त्रिन् m. one conversant with the six Śāstras or darśanas. --षष्टिः f. ( षट्षष्टिः) sixty-six. --सप्ततिः (षट्सप्ततिः) seventy-six.

s: strI, (zazWa + NIp .) kAtyAyanI । iti medinI ॥ zoqaSamAtfkAntargatamAtfkAviSezaH । sA prakfteH zazWIkalA skandaBAryyA ca । tasyAH svarUpAdiryaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA yA devasenA ca nArada ! । mAtfkAsu pUjyatamA sA ca zazWI prakIrttitA ॥ SiSUnAM prativiSvezu pratipAlanakAriRI । tapasvinI vizRuBaktA kArttikeyasya kAminI ॥ zazWAMSarUpA prakftestena zazWI prakIrttitA । puttrapOttrapradAtrI ca DAtrI trijagatAM satI ॥ sundarI yuvatI ramyA santataM Bartturantike । sTAne SiSUnAM paramA vfdDarUpA ca yoginI ॥ pUjA dvAdaSamAsezu yasyA viSvezu santatam । pUjA ca sUtikAgAre parA zazWadine SiSoH । ekaviMSatime cEva pUjA kalyARahetukI । SaSvanniyamitA cEzA nityA kAmyAhutiH parA ॥ mAtfrUpA dayArUpA SaSvadrakzaRarUpiRI । jale sTale cAntarIkze SiSUnAM svapnagocare ॥” iti brahmavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 1 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । SrInArAyaRa uvAca । “zazWAMSA prakfteryA ca sA tu zazWI prakIrttitA । tasyAH pUjAviDO brahman itihAsamimaM SfRu ॥ rAjA priyavrataScAsIt svAyamBuvamanoH sutaH । yogIndro na vahedBAryyAM tapasyAsu rataH sadA ॥ brahmAjYayA ca yatrena kftadAro baBUva saH । suciraM kftadAraSca na leBe tanayaM tataH ॥ puttrezwiyajYaM taYcApi kArayAmAsa kaSyapaH । mAninyE tasya kAntAyE muniryajYacaruM dadO ॥ BuktvA caruYca tasyASca sadyo garBo baBUva ha । daDAra taYca sA devI dEvaM dvAdaSavatsaram ॥ tataH suzAva sA brahman kumAraM kanakapraBam । sarvvAvayavasampannaM mftamuttAnalocanam ॥ SmaSAnaYca yayO rAjA gfhItvA bAlakaM mune । etasminnantare tatra vimAnaYca dadarSa ha ॥ dadarSa tatra devIYca kamanIyAM manoharAm । dfzwvA tAM purato rAjA tuzwAva paramAdaram ॥ papracCa rAjA tAM dfzwvA grIzmasUryyasamapraBAm । tejasA jvalitAM kAntAM SAntAM skandasya nArada ॥ priyavrata uvAca । kA tvaM suSoBane kasya kAnte kAntAsi suvrate । kasya kanyA varArohA DanyA mAnyA ca yozitAm ॥ devasenovAca । brahmaRo mAnasI kanyA devasenAhamISvarI । dfzwvA mAM manasA DAtA dadO skandAya BUmipa ॥ mAtfkAsu ca viKyAtA skandaBAryyA ca suvratA biSve zazWIti viKyAtA zazWASA prakfteryataH ॥ ityevamuktvA sA devI gfhItvA bAlakaM mune । mahAjYAnena tapasA jIvayAmAsa lIlayA ॥ gfhItvA bAlakaM devI gaganaM gantumudyatA । punastuzwAva tAM rAjA SuzkakaRWOzWatAlukaH ॥ nfpastotreRa sA devI parituzwA baBUva ha । uvAca taM nfpaM brahman ! vedoktaM karmmanirmmitam ॥ devasenovAca । trizu lokezu rAjA tvaM svAyamBuvamanoH sutaH । mama pUjAYca sarvvatra kArayitvA svayaM kuru ॥ tadA dAsyAmi puttrante kulapadmamanoharam । ityevamuktvA sA devI tasmE tadbAlakaM dadO ॥ rAjA cakAra svIkAraM tatpUjArTaYca suvrataH । jagAma devI svargaYca dattvA tasmE SuBaM varam ॥ AjagAma mahArAjaH svagfhaM hfzwamAnasaH । devIM tAM pUjayAmAsa brAhmaReByo DanaM dadO ॥ rAjA ca pratimAsezu SuklazazWyAM mahotsavam । zazWyA devyASca yatnena kArayAmAsa sarvvataH ॥ bAlAnAM sUtikAgAre zazWAhe yatnapUrvvakam । tApUjAM kArayAmAsa cEkaviMSativAsare ॥ bAlAnAM SuBakAryye ca SuBAnnaprASane taTA । sarvvatra vardDayAmAsa svayameva cakAra ha ॥ DyAnaM pUjAviDAnaYca stItraM matto niSAmaya । yat SrutaM DarmmavaktreRa kOTumoktaYca suvrata ॥ SAlagrAme Gawe vATa vawamUle'TavA mune । BittO puttalikAM kftvA pUjayedvA vicakzaRaH ॥ zazWAMSAM prakfteH SudDAM supratizWAYca supraBAm । suputtradAYca SuBadAM dayArUpAM jagatprasUm ॥ SvetacampakavarRABAM ratnaBUzaRaBUzitAm । pavitrarUpAM paramAM devasenAmahaM Baje ॥ iti DyAtvA svaSirasi puzpaM dattvA vicakzaRaH punarDyAtvA ca mUlena pUjayet suvratAM satIm ॥ pAdyArGyAcamanIyESca ganDaDUpapradIpakEH । nEvedyErviviDEScApi Palena SoBanena ca ॥ mUlenO~ hrI~ zazWIdevyE svAheti viDipUrvvakam azwAkzaraM mahAmantraM yaTASakti japennaraH ॥ tataH stutvA ca praRamedBaktiyuktaH samAhitaH । stotraYca sAmavedoktaM varaputtraPalapradam ॥ azwAkzaraM mahAmantraM lakzaDA yo japenmune । sa puttraM laBate nUnamityAha kamalodBavaH ॥ * ॥ stotraM SfRu muniSrezWa sarvvakAmaSuBAvaham । AjYApradaYca sarvvezAM gUQaM vedezu nArada ॥ priyavrata uvAca । namo devyE mahAdevyE sidDyE SAntyE namo namaH SuBAyE devasenAyE zazWyE devyE namo namaH ॥ varadAyE puttradAyE DanadAyE namo namaH । suKadAyE mokzadAyE zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ SaktizazWAMSarUpAyE sidDAyE ca namo namaH । mAyAyE sidDayoginyE zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ sArAyE sAradAyE ca pArAyE sarvvakAriRyE । bAlADizWAtfdevyE ca zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ kalyARadAyE kalyARyE PaladAyE ca karmmaRAm । pratyakzAyE ca BaktAnAM zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ pUjyAyE skandakAntAyE sarvvezAM sarvvakarmmasu । devarakzaRakAriRyE zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ SudDasattvasvarUpAyE vanditAyE nfRAM sadA । hiMsAkroDavarjjitAyE zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ DanaM dehi priyAM dehi puttraM deti sureSvari । DarmmaM dehi yaSo dehi zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ dehi BUmiM prajAM dehi vidyAM dehi supUjite । kalyARaYca jayaM dehi zazWIdevyE namo namaH ॥ iti devIYca saMstUya leBe puttraM priyavrataH । yaSasvinaYca rAjendraM zazWIdevIprasAdataH ॥ zazWIstotramidaM brahman yaH SfRoti ca vatsaram । aputtro laBate puttraM varaM sucirajIvinam ॥ varzamekaYca yA BaktA saMstutyedaM SfRoti ca । sarvvapApavinirmmuktyA mahAbanDyA rogayukte ca bAle ca pitA mAtA SfRoti cet mAsaYca mucyate bAlaH zazWIdevIprasAdataH ॥ iti brahmavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 40 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ candrasya zazWakalAkriyArUpatiTiviSezaH । sa tu SuklakfzRapakzaBedena dviviDaH । tatra candrasya vfdDyanukUlazazWakalAkriyArUpaH SuklapakzIyaH । tasya hrAsAnukUlazazWakalAkriyArUpaH kfzRapakzIyaH । * ॥ vESAKAdizu tasyA viSezanAmAni yaTA, -- “prasUtyA dvAdaSe mAsi sampUjyApatyavfdDaye । sute jAte taTA zazWyAM zazWI dvAdaSarUpiRI ॥ vESAKe cAndanI zazWI jyEzWe cAraRyasaMjYitA । AzAQe kArddamI jYeyA SrAvaRe luRWanI taTA ॥ BAdre capewI viKyAtA durgAKyASvayuje taTA । nAqyAKyA kArttike mAsi mArge mUlakarUpiRI pOze mAsyannarUpA ca SItalA tapasi smftA । gorUpiRI PAlgune ca cetre'SokA prakIrttitA ॥” iti skandapurARam ॥ tatkftyAdi yaTA, -- aTa zazWI sA saptamIyutA grAhyA yugmAt । rAjamArttaRqe । “jyEzWe mAsi site pakze zazWI cAraRyasaMjYitA vyajanEkakarAstasyAmawanti vipine striyaH ॥ tAM vinDyavAsinIM skandazazWImArADayanti ca । kandamUlaPalAhArA laBante santatiM SuBAm ॥” kandaM sUraRAdi । mUlaM taditarat । Bavizye । “yeyaM mArgaSire mAsi zazWI Baratasattama । puRyA pApaharA DanyA SivA SAntAguhapriyA ॥” devIpurARe cEtramaDikftya । “zazWyAM skandasya karttavyA pUjA sarvvopacArikA tahEva suKasOBAgyamante vizRupuraM vrajet ॥” iyameva skandazazWI paYcamIyutEvopozyA । “kfzRAzwamI skandazazWI SivarAtricaturdaSI । tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ sA ca kArttikeyABizekatiTiH । yaTA, -- “svayaM skando mahAdevaH sarvvapApapraRASanaH । tasya zazWIM tiTiM prAdAdaBizeke pitAmahaH ॥ asyAM PalASano yastu yajenniyatamAnasaH । skandotpattinAmADyAyaH ॥ * ॥ tatra jAtaPalam । “vidvAn varizWaScaturaH sukIrttiH pralambabAhurvraRakIrRagAtraH । satyapratizWo DanaputtrayuktaH zazWIprasUto manujaScirAyuH ॥” iti kozWIpradIpaH ॥ * ॥ tatra yAtrAkaraRadozo yaTA, -- “paYcamyAmIpsitArTaH syAt zazWyAM vyADiyuto Bavet । saptamyAmarTalABaH syAdazwamyAmastrapIqanam । zazWyazwamIdvAdaSIzu na gacCettridinaspfSi ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥

m: षष्ठी (ई), f. See below

a partic. Tithi when homage is offered to the sixth lunar digit, MW.
the sixth or genitive case, ŚrS.; Nir. &c.

the personification of a portion of Prakṛti, Cat.

a: षष्ठी — 1 The sixth day of a lunar fortnight --2 The sixth or genitive case (in gram.). --3 An epithet of Durgā in the form of Kātyāyanī, one of the 16 divine mothers. --Comp. --तत्पुरुषः the genitive Tatpurusha compound, one in which, when dissolved, the first member usually stands in the genitive case. --पूजनं, --पूजा worship of the goddess षष्ठी performed on the sixth day after a woman's delivery.

s: [n] puM, yajYapAtraviSezaH । yaTA atirAtre zoqaSinaM gfhRAti nAtirAtre zoqaSinaM gfhRAtIti । zoqaSI sasomakapAtraviSezaH । iti malamAsatattvam ॥

strI, dvAdaSamahAvidyAntargatavidyAviSezaH । yaTA, -- “kAlI tArA mahAvidyA zoqaSI BuvaneSvarI । BEravI CinnamastA ca vidyA DUmAvatI taTA ॥ vagalA sidDavidyA ca mAtaNgI kamalAtmikA । etA daSa mahAvidyAH sidDavidyAH prakIrttitAH ॥” tatra pAriBAzikIM zAqaSImAha jYAnArRave । “candrAntaM vAruRAntaYca SakrAdimahitaM pfTak । vAmAkzibindunAdAQyaM viSvamAtfkalAtmakam ॥ vidyAdO yojayeddevi sAkzAt jAgratsvarUpiRI । vikuwAH sakalA BedAH paYcakUwA Bavanti hi । vEzRavI vasukUwA syAt zawkUwA SANkarI Bavet ॥” asyArTaH candrAntaM hakAraH । vAruRAntaM SakAraH । SakrAdI rePaH । vAmAkzi IkAraH । vidyAdO purvvoktadvAdaSavidyAdO । “vedAdimaRqitA devi SivaSaktimayI sadA । tadA BedAstu sakalAH zawkUwA parameSvari । vEzRavI navakUwA syAt saptakUwA ca SANkarI ॥” asyArTaH SivaSaktimayI pUrvvoktA bIjadvayavatI । vedAdiH praRavaH । maRqitA AdO BUzitA ॥ * ॥ aTa mahAzoqaSI । “AdyavIjadvayaM Badre viparItakrameRa hi । viliKya parameSAni tato'nyAni samudDaret ॥ antarmmuKI varArohe kumArI tripureSvarI । eBistu paYcasaMKyAkErbIjEH saMpuwitAM yajet ॥ zawkUwAM parameSAni vidyeyaM zoqaSAkzarI । trikUwAH saPalA Badre zoqaSArRA Bavanti hi । vEzRavyekonaviMSArRA SEvI saptadaSAkzarI ॥” asyArTaH । AdyabIjadvayaM mAyAramAtmakam । viparItakramaH AdO ramA paScAnmAyA । antarmaDya sTitaM kAmabIjaM muKe AdO yasyAH kumAryyAH । eBiH paYcasaMKyAkErbIjEH zawkUwAM saptakUwAM navakUwAM vA saMpuwitAM saMpuwavat kftAM tenAMnulomavilomataH saMpuwitAmityarTaH । yoginItantre । “SrIbIjamAyAsmarayoniSaktistAraYca mAyA kamalATa vidyA । SaktyAdibIjESca vilomatoktyA SrIzoqaSIyaYca SivapradizwA ॥” taTA ca rudrayAmale । “SrIrmmAyA madano vARI parA tAraM SivapriyA । haripriyA trikUwA sA parA vARI manoBavaH । mAtAlakzmIrmmahAvidyA SrIbIjaM zoqaSI parA ॥” aTa bIjAvalI zoqaSI । rudrayAmale । “SrIbIjamAye saMliKya taTEva ca kumArikAm । SrIbIjamAye kAmaYca vANmAyA kamalA taTA ॥ parAM kAmaYca vAgbIjaM mAyA SrIbI jameva ca । bIjAvalI zoqaSIyaM sarvvatantrezu gopitA ॥ rAjyaM deyaM Siro deyaM na deyA zoqaSAkzarI ॥” * ॥ tantrAntare । “AdyA kuRqalinI SaktiH SaktirAdyA tataH parA niveSayettayormmaDye devi govindavallaBAm ॥ tatastu manmaTaM bIjaM SrIbIjaM tadanantaram । hflleKA raBayorvaktre vedavaktraM viniHkzipet ॥ tato lopA nyaseddevi trikUwAmaTavA parAm । AdyAni paYcabIjAni paScAdvinyasya sundari । zoqaSIyaM sugopyA hi snehAddevi prakASitA ॥ asyA mAhAtmyamatulaM jihvAkowiSatErapi । vaktuM na Sakyate devi ki punaH paYcaBirmuKEH ॥ api priyatamaM deyaM sutadAraDanAdikam । rAjyaM deyaM Siro deyaM na deyA zoqaSAkzarI ॥” tantrAntare । “sindUrarajasA vApi kuNku mena vilepite । liKitvA darSayedBUmO na ca karRe prakASayet ॥ tataH svAtmaviSudDyarTaM lakzamekaM japedguruH ॥” * ॥ bIjazoqaSImAha । sidDayAmale । kAmo mAyA ramA bAlA trikUwA strI BagANkuSO । kAlI kAmakalA kUrccaM sarvvAdO praRavaH priye ॥ SrImahAzoqaSIyaYca yA KyAtA Buvanatraye । jYAnena mftyuhA vidyA sarvvAmnAyErnamaskftA ॥ saptalakzamahAvidyAstantrAdO kaTitAH priye । sArAtsAratarA BUtA yA yA vidyAH sugopitAH ॥ bahunA kimihoktena tAsAM sArA tu zoqaSI । prakASitA mahAdevI yA pfzwA te punaH punaH ॥” * SAktakAmarAjantu SrIkrame । “mAyAbIjaM taTA JiRwI kAmaM SakraM viyat kramAt । jAtavedo mfgANkena lAYCitaM parameSvarI ॥ etadvAgBavakUwaYca pUrvvavat kAmarAjakam । taTEva SaktibIjantu sundaryyezA prakIrttitA ॥” atrApi pUrvvavadbIjasaMyogaH । mAyA IkAraH । JiRwI ekAraH । punaH SAktamAha । “etadBagaM tato mAyA brahmA Sakro haro'gninA vAmanetreRa saMyukto nAdabinduviBUzitaH । etadvAgBavamuddizwaM pUrvvavat kAmaSaktikam ॥” Baga ekAraH । atrApi pUrvvavadbIjasaMyogaH । atra viSezaH । “brahmabIjaM yadA dadyAt trikUwezu varAnane । praTamA sundarI devI dvitIyA brahmasundarI ॥ SaktikUwe maheSAni anantasundarI matA । ezA tu sundarI vidyA mataBedena darSitA ॥ trikUwAnte haMsavIjaM bindusargaviBUzitam । ezA SrIprARasaMyuktA dAridyraduHKamocinI ॥” iti tantrasAraH ॥ * ॥ UnaviMSatipiRqadAnakriyA । yaTA, -- pretaSiloktarItyA dvAdaSapiRqAn zoqaSIpiRqAMSca dadyAt । iti tIrTayAtrAprayogatattvam tadviDAnaM yaTA, -- “amAvasyAntu kanyArke tIrTaprAptO taTA nfpa kftvA SrAdDaM viDAnena dadyAt zoqaSapiRqakam ॥ vAyupurARIyastatprayogo yaTA । UnaviMSatidAsyamAnapriRqasTAnAni yaTAdakziRaM BAgacatuzwayena kftAni tatra dakziRAgrAn kuSAn AstIryya । “asmatkule mftA ye ca gatiryezAM na vidyate । AvAhayizye tAn sarvvAn darBapfzWe tilodakEH ॥ mAtAmahakule ye ca gatiryezAM na vidyate । AvAhayizye tAn sarvvAt darBapfzWe tilodakEH banDuvargakule ye ca gatiryeyAM na vidyate । AvAhayizye tAn sarvvAn darBapfzWe tilodakEH ॥” ityetEstilodakErAvAhya । “AbrahmastambaparyyantaM devarzipitfmAnavAH । tfpyantu pitaraH sarve mAtfmAtAmahAdayaH ॥ atItakulakowInAM saptadvIpanivAsinAm । AbrahmaBuvanAllokAdidamastu tilodakama .” ityetAByAM tilodakAYjalIn dadyAt । tato mUlAditaH pitftIrTena piRqAn dadyAt । tatra kramaH “asmatkule mftA ye ca gatiryezAM na vidyate । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 1 ॥ mAtAmahakule ye ca gatiryezAM na vidyate । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 2 ॥ banDuvargakule ye ca gatiryezAM na vidyate । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 3 ॥ ajAtadantA ye kecit ye ca garBe prapIqitAH । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 4 ॥ agnidagDASca ye kecinnAgnidagDAstaTA pare । vidyuccOrahatA ye ca teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 5 dAvadAhe mftA ye ca miMhavyAGrahatASca ye । dazwriBiH SfNgiBirvvApi teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 6 ॥ udbanDanamftA ye ca vizaSastrahatASca ye । AtmApaGAtino ye ca teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 7 araRye vartmani vane kzuDayA tfzayA hatAH । BUtapratapiSAcASca teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ vane jale ॥ 8 ॥ rOrave cAnDatAmisre kAlasUtre ca ye sTitAH । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 9 ॥ anekayAtanAsaMsTAH pretaloke ca ye gatAH । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 10 ॥ anekayAtanAsaMsTA ye nItA yamakiNkarEH । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 11 ॥ narakezu samastezu yAtanAsu ca ye sTitAH । tezAmudDaraRATayi imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 12 ॥ paSuyonigatA ye ca pakzikIwasarIsfpAH । aTavA vfkzayonisTAsteByaH piRqa dadAmyaham ॥ 13 ॥ jAtyantarasahasrezu BramantaH svena karmmaRA । mAnuzyaM durllaBaM yezAM teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 14 divyantarIkzaBUmizWAH pitaro bAnDavAdayaH । mftA asaMskftA ye ca teByaH piRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ 15 ॥ ye kecit pretarUpeRa varttante pitaro mama । te sarvve tfptimAyAntu piRqadAnena sarvadA ॥ 16 ye'bAnDavA bAnDavA vA ye'nyajanmani bAnDavAH । tezAM piRqo mayA dattaH akzayyamupatizWatAm ॥ 17 pitfvaMSe mftA ye ca mAtfvaMSe ca ye mftAH । guruSvaSurabanDUnAM ye cAnye bAnDavA mftAH ॥ ye me kule luptapiRqAH puttadAravivarjjitAH । kriyAlopagatA ye ca jAtyanDAH paNgavastaTA ॥ virUpA AmagarBASca jYAtAjYAtAH kule mama । tezAM piRqo mayA dattaH akzayyamupatizWatAm ॥ 18 AbrahmaRo ye pitfvaMSajAtA mAtustaTA vaMSaBavA madIyAH । kuladvaye ya mama dAsaBUtA BftyAstayEvASritasevakASca ॥ mitrARi saKyaH paSavaSca vfkzA dfzwA hyadfzwASca kftopakArAH । janmAntare ye mama dAsaBUtAsteByaH svaDA piRqamahaM dadAni ॥ 19 ॥ atronaviMSatipiRqe zoqaSapiRqatvaM pAriBAzikaM paYcAmravat । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ etezAM mantrARAM strIliNgohena strIzoqaSItvaM Bavati ॥ * aTa mAtfzoqaSI । “garBAdavagame cEva vizame BUmivartmani । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ mAsi mAsi kftaM kazwaM vedanA prasavezu ca । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ SETilye prasave cEva mAturatyantaduzkaram । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ padByAM janayate mAturduHKaYcEva sudustaram । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ padByAmityatra dadByAmiti ca pAWaH ॥ 4 ॥ agninA Sozate dehaM trirAtrAnaSanezu ca । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ pibecca kawudravyARi kleSAni viviDAni ca । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ durllaBaM Bakzadravyasya tyAge vindati yat Palam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ rAtrO mUtrapurIzAByAM Bidyate mAtfkarpawam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ puttraM vyADisamAyuktaM mAtfduHKamaharniSam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ yadA puttro na laBate tadA mAtuSca Socanam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ kzuDayAM vihvale puttre dadAti nirBaraM stanam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ divA rAtrO yadA mAtuH SozaRaYca punaH punaH । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ pUrRe tu daSame mAsi mAturatyantaduzkaram । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ gAtraBaNgo BavenmAtustfptiM nEva prayacCati । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ alpAhAravatI mAtA yAvat puttro'sti bAlakaH tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ yamadvAre mahADIre paTi mAtuSca Socanam । tasyA nizkramaRArTAya mAtfpiRqaM dadAmyaham ॥ iti gayAyAM prasidDiH ॥

s: klI, (zoqaSaprakAraM dAnam .) SrAdDAdO zoqaSaprakAradeyadravyam । tatkramamAhuH sAmpradAyikAH । “BUByAmanaM jalaM vastraM pradIpo'nnaM tataH param । tAmbalacCatraganDASca mAlyaM PalamataH param ॥ SayyA ca pAdukA gAvaH kAYcanaM rajataM taTA । dAnametat zoqaSakaM pretamuddiSya dIyate ॥” tat zoqaSazoqaSakEreko dAnasAgaro Bavati ॥ tatra BUmeH pUjAyAM dAnavAkye ca priyadatteti viSezaRam । BUmerddevatA vizRuH zazWivarzasahasrAvacCinnasvargavAsaH Palam । pratigrahe tadBUmeH pradakziRIkaraRam । tadBUmerasanniDAne tAmuddiSya pradakziRam ॥ 1 ॥ Asanasya uttAnANgiraso devatA rAjyasTAnAnuttamasvargaprAptiH Palam । tatra viSezAnupadeSAt karamaDyAtmAgneyena tIrTena pratigrahaH । evamanyatrApi AgneyaM karatalam ॥ 2 ॥ jalasya varuRo devatA tfptiprAptiH Palam ॥ 3 ॥ vastrasya bfhaspatirddevatA candrasAlokyaprAptiH Palam । pratigrahe daSAntagrahaRapariDAne ॥ 4 ॥ dIpasya agnirddevatA uttamacakzuH prAptiH Palam ॥ 5 ॥ annasya prajApatirdevatA akzayasuKaprAptiH Palam । pratigrahe muzwigrahaRam ॥ 6 ॥ tAmbUlasya vanaspatirdevatA meDAvitvasuBagatvaprAjYatvadarSanIyatvaprAptiH Palam ॥ 7 ॥ Catrasya uttAnANgiraso devatA sarvvavyADivinirmuktatvaSrImattvabahuputtratvaprAptiH Palam । pratigrahe daRqaDAraRam ॥ 8 ॥ ganDasya ganDarvvo devatA brahmapadaprayARaM Palam ॥ 9 ॥ mAlyasya vanaspati rdevatA atyantasuKitvaBavanaM Palam ॥ 10 PalasyavanaspatirdevatA mudA yuktatvaM Palam ॥ 11 ॥ SayyAyAH uttAnANgiraso devatA atyantasuKitva BavanaM Palam । pratigrahe ArohaRam ॥ 12 ॥ pAdukAyugalasya uttAnANgiraso devatA sarvvalokasuKagamanaM Palam । pratigrahe ArohaRam ॥ 13 ॥ Deno rudro devatA sUryyalokaprAptiH Palam । tatra DenuM prANmuKImAtmasamIpamAnIya । “o~ yA lakzmIH sarvvaBUtAnAM yA ca devezvavasTitA । DenurUpeRa sA devI mama SAntiM prayacCatu ॥ o~ devasTA yA ca rudrARI SaNkarasya ca yA priyA । DenurUpeRa sA devI mama SAntiM prayacCatu ॥ o~ vizRorvakzasi yA lakzmIryA lakzmIrDanadasya ca । yA lakzmIH sarvvaBUtAnAM sA DenurvaradAstu me ॥ o~ caturmuKasya yA lakzmIH svAhA cEva viBAvasoH । candrArkaSakraSaktiryA DenurUpAstu sA Sriye ॥ o~ svaDA tvaM pitfsaMGAnAM svAhA yajYaBUjAM yataH । sarvvapApaharA DenustasmAcCAntiM prayacCa me ॥ sarvvadevamayIM devIM sarvvavedamayIntaTA । sarvvalokanimittAya sarvvalokamapi sTirAm । prayacCAmi mahABAgAmakzayAya suKAya ca ॥” ityuccAryya utsfjet । pratigrahe pucCaDAraRam ॥ 14 ॥ hiraRyasyAgnirdevatA dIrGAyuHprAptiH Palam ॥ 15 ॥ rajatasya candramA devatA uttamarUpaprAptiH Palam ॥ 16 ॥ iti SudDitattvam ॥ * ॥ gayApadDatyuktazoqaSadAdanaM yaTA, “svarRaM rOpyaM taTA tAmraM kAMsyaM gAvo gajA hayAH । gfhaM BUmirvfzo vastraM SAyyA kzetramupAnahO ॥ dAsyannaM pitfyajYezu dAnaM zoqaSakaM matam ॥” iti vAyupurARe gayAmAhAtmyam ॥

a: षोडशन् — num. a. (pl.) Sixteen. --Comp. --अंशुः the planet Venus. --अंग a. having 16 parts or ingredients. --(गः) a kind of perfume. --अंगुलक a. having the breadth of 16 fingers. --अंध्रिः a crab. --अर्चिस् m. the planet Venus. --आवर्तः a conch-shell. --उपचार m. pl. the sixteen ways of doing homage to a deity &c.: they are thus enumerated:--आसनं स्वागतं पाद्यमर्घ्यमाचमनीयकम् . मधुपर्काचम नानं वसनाभरणानि च . गंधपुष्पे धूपदीपौ नैवेद्यं वंदनं तथा. --कलाः the sixteen digits of the moon, thus named:--अमृता मानदा पूषा तुष्टिः पुष्टी रतिर्धृतिः . शशिनी चंद्रिका कांतिर्ज्योत्स्ना श्रीः प्रीतिरेव च . अंगदा च तथा पूर्णामृता षोडश वै कलाः ... --भुजा a form of Durgā. --मातृका f. pl. the sixteen divine mothers; they are: --गौरी पद्मा शची मेघा सावित्री विजया जया . देवसेना स्वधा स्वाहा मातरो लोकमातरः . शांतिः पुष्टिर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः कुलदेवात्मदेवताः.

s: Na sarpaRe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-saka-sew .) vakArayuktAdiH kopaDaH । Na, zvakkate zizvakkizate zAzvakkyate । dantyaviDAvasya varjjanAnna dantyaH । candrodayastu imaM paYcamasvariRaM matvA zukkate zuzukkizate zozukkyate ityAha ॥ iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: sarpaRe BvA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । zvakkate azpakkizwa ।

s: O Yi Na AliNge । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-Atma॰-saka॰-aniw .) vakArayuktAdiH । AliNga AliNganam । O, svaNktA । Yi, svakto'sti । Na, svajate yuvatIM yuvA । parizvajati pAYcAlI maDyamaM pARqunandanamiti gaRakftAnityatvAt । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: AliNgane BvA॰ A॰ sa॰ aniw । svajate asvaNkta ।

s: O Ga lu Yi Saye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adA॰-para-aka॰-aniw .) vakArayuktamUrdDanyAdiH । O, asvApsIt । Ga lu, svapiti । Yi, supto'sti । SayaH Sayanam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: Sayane nidrAyAYca adA॰ svapA॰ jakzA॰ para॰ aka॰ aniw । svapiti asvApsIt suzvApa ।

s: ka gatyAm । taNke । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰-para॰-saka॰-taNke aka॰-sew .) vakArayuktamUrdDanyAdiH । taNko duHKena jIvanam । ka, svarttayati jano gacCati duHKena jIvati vetyarTaH । asizvarttat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: gatO saka॰ duHKena jIvane aka॰ cu॰ u॰ sew । svarttayati te asasvarttat ta ।

m: ष्वस्क् See preceding.
ष्वष्क् cl. 1. P. ष्वष्कति (Naigh. ii, 14) or cl. 1. Ā. ष्वष्कते (Dhātup. iv, 26; v.l. ष्वस्क्, स्वस्क्; cf. prec. and षुक्क्, षष्क्), to go, move.

v: gatO BvA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । zvazkate azvazkizwa । zopadeSa paryudAse srakkavat zvazkasyApi grahaRAt zvazkate ityevetyAhuH ।

s: x O ya A Yi svidi । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-para॰-aka॰-aniw .) x, asvidat । O, svettA । ya, svidyati । A, sveditaM svinnaM tena । Yi, svinno'sti । svidIti mohasnehamokzezviti vopadevaH । gAtraprakzaraRe iti prAYcaH । na ca svidyati tasyANgamiti halAyuDaH ॥ iti durgAdAsaH ॥

Yi A Na x mohasnehamokzezu । iti kavikalpadrumaH । (BvA॰-Atma॰-aka॰-sew .) Yi, svinno'sti ॥ A, sveditaM svinnaM tena । Na, svedate tilaH tElaM muYcati ityarTaH । x, asvidat snehaH snigDIBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: mohe mnehe ca aka॰ mocane saka॰ BvA॰ A॰ luNi u॰ sew । svedate asvidat asvedizwa ।
gAtraprakzaraRe aka॰ di॰ para॰ aniw । svidyati xdit asvidat । iti SrItArAnATatarkavAcaspatiBawwacAryyasaNkalite vAcaspatyABiDAne zakArAdi SabdArTasaNkalanam ।
vezwane saka॰ BvA॰ para॰ aniw । stAyati astAsIt ।

s: U Sa vaDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰para॰-saka॰-vew .) mUrdDanyAdiH tamaDyaH । azwamasvarI । U, astFhIt astFkzat । Sa stFhatI stFhantI । tizwFhayizati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: baDe tu॰ Atma॰ saka॰ vew । stFhati astFhIt astFkzat

s: ya klede । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰para॰-aka॰-sew .) ya, zwImyati tizwIma । kleda ArdraBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: klede di॰ pa॰ a॰ sew । stImyati astImIt stImanam ।

s: ka ucCrAye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) zazWasvarI । ucCrAyo rASIkaraRam । ka, stUpayati DAnyaM kfzakaH । tuzwUpayizati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ya ir ucCrAye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-para॰-saka॰-sew .) zazWasvarI । ya, stUpyati । ir, astUpat astUpIt । puzAditvAnnityaM Na ityanye । atuzwUpat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: ucCrAye ada॰ cu॰ uBa॰ aka॰ sew । stUpayati te atuzwUpat ta stUpaH ।
ucCAye di॰ para॰ aka॰ sew । stUpyati irit astUpat astUpIt ।

s: i Na stamBe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-aka॰-saka॰-casew .) i, stamByate । Na, stamBate । tizwamBayizati । ikArasya punaruktiH pUrvvatra tatsambanDanizeDAyEva Nitastusarve । eka evet pAWabalAt vADya iti vat । stamBo jaqI BAvaH jaqIkaraRaYca । stamBO sTURAjaqIBAvO ityamarokteH । SItenAvastabDaH jaqIkfta ityarTaH । iti kramadISvarokteSca । stamBa iha kriyA niroDaH । iti BImaH । dIzavfdDiriti govinda BawwaH । stamBo rudDIkaraRaYca । stamBate kabAwena dvAraM lokaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: stamBe aka॰ stamBane saka॰ BvA॰ Atma॰ sew iQi । stamBate astamBizwa ।

s: ma e saMvftO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) ma, tizwagayizati । dantyavargadvitIyopaDa iti kecit । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: saMvaraRe BvA॰ pa॰ saka sew edit sici na vfdDiH GawA॰ । stagati astagIt ।

s: ma pratIGAte । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰ para॰-saka॰-sew .) ma, tizwakayizati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: pratIGAte BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । stakati astA (sta) kIt GawAdi॰ akayati ।

m: ष्टम्भ् See √ स्तम्भ्.

s: vEklavye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰aka॰-sew .) vEklavyaM vihvalIBAvaH । stamati । atizwamat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
t ka vEklavye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adanta curA॰-para॰-aka॰-sew .) mUrdDanyAdiH । zopadeSapAWo BvAdyAdIti dantyatve kftasakArAditvAt zatvArTaH । tizwamayizati । evaM sarvatra । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vEkalye ada॰ cu॰ u॰ sa॰ sew । stamayati te atastamat ta
vEkalye aka॰ BvA॰ para॰ sew । stamati astamIta ।

s: mi Sabde । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-aka॰-sew .) mi, stanayati stAnayati atizwanat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: Sabde BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew vA GawA॰ । stanati astAnIt astanIt stA(sta)nayati ।

s: f Na Scyuti । itikavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰ Atma॰-aka॰-sew .) F, atizwepat । Na, stepate tizwepe । Scyuti kzaraRe । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: kzaraRe BvA॰ A॰ aka॰ sew fdat caNi na hrasvaH । stepate astepizwa ।

s: U Sa vaDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰para॰-saka॰-vew .) mUrdDanyAdiH tamaDyaH । U, astarhIt । astfkzat । Sa, stfhatI stfhantI । tizwarhayizati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: baDe tu॰ pa॰ saka॰ vew । stFhati astarhIt astFkzat ।

s: gamane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰ saka॰-sew .) saptamasvarayuktaH tamaDyaH । stfkzati tarIzwfkzyate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: gatO BvA॰ pa॰ sa॰ sew । stfkzati astfkzIt tarIzwfkzyate

s: na Na Askadi । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (svA॰-Atma॰-saka॰-sew .) Askat Askandanam । aBiyoga iti BawwamallaH । na Na, stiGnute nadIM pAnTaH । tizwiGe । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: aBiyAge svA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । stiGnate astoGazwa ।

s: ya klede । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰para॰-aka॰-sew .) ya, stimyati tizwema । kledaH ArdraBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: klede di॰ pa॰ aka॰ sew । stimyati astemIt stemanam

s: f Na Scyuti । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-aka॰-sew .) f, atizwepat । Na, stepate tizwepe । Scyuti kzaraRe । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: kzaraRe BvA॰ Atma॰ aka॰ sew fdit caNi na hrasvaH । stepate astepizwa । atizwepat ta ।

s: Ya la stutO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ adA॰uBa॰-saka॰-aniw .) mUrdDanyAdiH । Ya la, stOti stavIti stute । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: stutO adA॰ u॰ saka॰ aniw sici sew liwi nityew stOti stavIti stutaH stuvAtaH stute stuvIta si॰ kO॰ mugDaboDamate apiti na Iw stute ityevati BedaH । astAvIt astozwa । tuzwuviva । tAdAvardDaDAtuke vew । stotA stavitA । stozyati stutaH ।

s: u Na stamBe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰ Atma॰-aka॰-saka॰ ca-sew । ktvAvew .) u, stoBitvA । stubDvA । Na, stoBate tuzwoBayizati । stamBo jaqIBAvaH tatkaraRaYca । stamBO sTURAjaqIBAvAvityamarokteH । SItenAvastabDo jaqIkfta ityarTaH । iti kramadISvarokteSca । “SAstreRa stoBate BUyo laGuprakftiko naraH .” iti halAyuDaH । stoBate vfzaM SIto vAyuH । iti caturBujaH । stamBa iha kriyAniroDaH । iti BImaH । dozavfdDiriti govindaBawwaH । iti durgAdAsaH ।
v: stamBe aka॰ stamBane saka॰ BvA॰ Atma॰ sew ktvA vew । stoBate astoBizwa ।

v: prasAde aka॰ BvA॰ Atma॰ sew । stocate astocizwa ।

s: saMhatO । DvanO । itikavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰ para॰-aka॰-aniw .) antaHsTAdyayuktadantyavargAdyamaDyaH zayogAt waH । tena tazwyO । tazwyAsati । tAzwyAyate । saMhatiH samUhaH । zwyAyati lokaH ekatra samUhAyate SabdAyate vA ityarTaH ॥ dantyaviDO zwyEzvakkazWivAM varjjanAnna dantyaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: saMhatO DvatO ca aka॰ BvA॰ para॰ aniw । styAyati । astyAsIt ityeke । zatyAyati ityeveti ।
m: ष्ट्यै See √ स्त्यै.
ष्ट्युम or ष्ट्यूम, m. (perhaps w.r. for ष्ठ्यूम fr. √ ष्ठिव्, or स्यूम fr. √ सिव्; only L.) the moon; light; water; thread; auspiciousness.
